name: yq
description: Portable YAML processor with jq-like syntax supporting JSON, XML, CSV, TSV, and property formats

yq.description: Portable YAML processor with jq-like syntax supporting multiple formats (YAML, JSON, XML, CSV, TSV, properties)
yq.usage:
yq '.name' config.yaml
yq -i '.version = "2.0"' config.yaml
yq -o json config.yaml
yq '.servers[] | select(.env == "prod")' config.yaml
yq -P '.databases.*.host' config.yaml
